$comment: Every `Discover*` filter that excludes a subject the world contains and does not publish a reason. `tools/check-stardew-discovery-exclusions.mjs` names each entry whose function no longer exists or no longer filters on `member` (backlog_stale), each entry whose `token` is now in the closed vocabulary (backlog_token_available - the family can publish today), and each entry whose disposition names no class (backlog_unreasoned). Classes: 'token pending: <state>' (the state has no token yet), 'not vanilla: <who deletes it>' (the engine does not refuse this; the filter is a defect), 'kind test: <why the member names this family's subject rather than a state it withholds>'.

entries.disposition: token pending: not_ready - a building still under construction stands on the map and has no door yet (Building.daysOfConstructionLeft). The token exists, so this family can publish today; owner: the animal-door lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.animaldooractions.cs:315.

token pending: not_ready - the same construction countdown decides whether a building is a finished target. Owner: the farm-building lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.buildfarmbuildingactions.cs.
token pending: not_ready - a building under construction exposes no loadable chest. Owner: the building-chest lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.buildingchestactions.cs:523.
token pending: not_ready - a pond under construction has nothing to clear. Owner: the fish-pond lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.pondactions.cs:270.
token pending: not_ready - an obelisk under construction cannot be used. Owner: the obelisk lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.obeliskactions.cs.

token pending: not_ready - `CrabPot.NeedsBait` is true for a pot with no bait (CrabPot.cs:64-71), so it cannot be catching anything yet. The token exists; owner: the crab-pot lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.cs DiscoverCrabPotCollectTargets.

token pending: not_ready - the whole-map harvest COUNT omits locations whose crops are not ripe, and the count it publishes already says zero for them. Owner: the harvest lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.cs DiscoverHarvestWhereabouts.

token pending: wrong_harvest_method - the count omits scythe-harvest crops for the same reason `harvestTargets` does. Owner: the harvest lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.cs DiscoverHarvestWhereabouts.

token pending: dead - the whole-map watering COUNT omits dead crops (HoeDirt.cs:732-735), which no water can bring back. Owner: the watering lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.cs DiscoverWateringWhereabouts.

token pending: already_tapped - a tapped stump is not the readback of this action's own swing. Owner: the chop-tree lane, integrations/stardew/farmhandexecutioncontroller.cs DiscoverTreeChopResultTargets.
kind test: the family's SUBJECT is a felled tree - `stump.Value` selects it rather than withholding a standing tree from it. The state reason `stump` belongs to `chop_tree`, which has it.
kind test: `growthStage >= Tree.treeStage` selects a mature felled tree; a sapling cannot be felled at all, so there is no withheld subject to count.
kind test: `health == 5f` selects the exact durability this action's own swing produced - a postcondition readback, not a target list that could withhold a subject.

not vanilla: a mossy tree IS a chop source in the engine - `Tree.performToolAction` harvests the moss and falls into the axe branch in the SAME swing (Tree.cs:1087-1120) - so this filter withholds a subject vanilla allows. It is not tokenised and its behaviour is unchanged; the chop-tree lane deletes the predicate, and this entry then goes red as backlog_stale so the register cannot outlive the filter.
kind test: `chop_stump`'s subject IS the stump; the predicate selects it. The `stump` reason belongs to `chop_tree`, which excludes it.
kind test: `shake_tree`'s subject is a standing tree; a felled one belongs to `chop_stump`, so nothing a shake could act on is withheld.
